title: Desktop overview
workflow: Inspect system, queued work, recent receipts and the current workspace without leaving the desktop. This is a composition, not another scheduler or agent.
acceptance: Offline and model-unavailable states leave launcher, windows, clock and system controls usable. No invented health score or agent roster.

title: Computer / Conversation
workflow: Converse with Computer, review action receipts and select the existing voice mode. Keep the composer, context budget and stop control visible.
acceptance: Stopping dispatch cancels through the existing owner. Audio indicators reflect actual capture state; the theme never acquires a microphone.

title: Library / Capability catalog
workflow: Browse Tasks, paired Tool–Skill entries and Agents. Filters select existing identities, then open the one Reader.
acceptance: No fictional ontology categories, no duplicate Article writer, and no click that executes a Tool simply because it appears in the catalog.

title: Tasks / Execution queue
owner: Task runtime, scheduler, existing ADK execution
workflow: See trigger, Agent, model, runtime status and receipts together. Open the Task definition separately from a particular activation.
acceptance: Runtime transitions never rewrite the Article. Cancel, retry and activation actions keep their existing permission and uncertain-outcome semantics.

title: Reviews / Change approval
owner: Existing Review owner and revision-checked writer
workflow: Inspect proposed text and relationship changes alongside evidence; accept or reject one exact revision.
acceptance: A stale revision disables approval and requests a new comparison. Green text indicates additions, not proof of factual correctness.

title: Reader / Article and evidence
workflow: Read an Article, inspect links, evidence and agent checkouts, edit through revision checks; dock Knowledge and Source at the edges.
acceptance: One viewer, one loaded identity; binary, truncated, read-only and externally managed Sources remain clearly distinguished.

title: Knowledge / Explorer
workflow: Search the real Article tree grouped by agent assignment; open selected refs in Reader or locate them in the shared graph.
acceptance: Node names and assignments come from graph.navigation. Docking changes the existing layout record, not a second file tree or renderer.

title: Graph / Knowledge
owner: Single canonical graph presenter; frame-viewer pane
workflow: Navigate the six Article types and current agent identities with an inspector and readable evidence list.
acceptance: Theme changes must not reheat simulation, rewrite positions, invent links or alter selection/picking. Miniature atlas graph is an illustrative diagram only.

title: Graph / Historical memory
workflow: Switch the existing viewer to Memory, select a bank and time range, open an exact returned memory record.
acceptance: Memory records remain provider records, never invented Article types; chronology and actual returned IDs remain intact.

title: Graph / Code
owner: Existing code graph provider + same viewer
workflow: Switch to Code, select a project, inspect symbol dependencies and observed tool activity.
acceptance: No second code graph solver. Proximity does not imply dependency; activity labels never expose hidden reasoning or imply success.

title: Source / Provenance explorer
workflow: Inspect System, Knowledge and Evidence trees, coverage and checkouts. Keep path, provenance and read-only status obvious.
acceptance: Source is not a general-purpose file manager. Opening evidence never grants execution or changes its immutable provenance.

title: Models / Residency and capacity
workflow: Inspect available task models, allowed GPUs, context limits and measured performance. Make configuration and benchmark costs explicit.
acceptance: A presentation theme never loads, evicts or benchmarks a model. Unknown performance is unavailable, not a fabricated estimate.

title: Hardware / Performance
workflow: Inspect Summary, CPU, memory, GPUs, storage and network with one selected resource and bounded charts.
acceptance: Keep on-demand sampling, missing-data gaps and read-only process identity. No new sampler thread or polling daemon.

title: Hardware / Processes
workflow: Sort read-only processes by resource use; show sample time, process identity and unavailable measurements.
acceptance: Do not quietly add kill-process controls to this read-only interface. Sorting remains presentation only.

title: Camera / Preview
workflow: See the selected camera and explicit preview state, retry a failed preview, and open AI & Voice device settings.
acceptance: No microphone, no second capture owner, no camera-power change on close. A closed preview must never be shown as recording.

title: Media / Library and playback
owner: Existing media/TV owner and command receipts
workflow: Select a library item, target playback, resume or seek, and verify the matching command receipt.
acceptance: Keep target identity and command status explicit; no invented universal playback authority or second media server.

title: Media / Discovery and readiness
owner: Existing media search and acquisition owner
workflow: Search metadata, choose season/episode, inspect eligible sources and readiness before sending an authorized acquisition request.
acceptance: Distinguish metadata match, source availability, acquisition eligibility, command accepted and actual playback.

title: Applications / Installed software
workflow: Find installed software, launch through the existing app owner, search packages and inspect install/remove confirmation.
acceptance: Package metadata is untrusted display content; launching and package mutations retain their own validation and authorization.

title: Applications / Updates
owner: Existing PackageKit adapter; extend transaction projection
workflow: Inspect the update set, dependencies, restart requirements and transaction history before applying a system update.
acceptance: Never perform Arch partial upgrades; expose transaction failure honestly. Existing install/search does not prove update UI completeness.

title: Terminal / Console and agent canvas
workflow: Keep Local Console, Active Trace and Agent Canvas as views of the existing terminal owner, with explicit session labels and copy/paste.
acceptance: Theme reload cannot detach, recreate or replace tmux sessions. ANSI colors retain distinct semantics on an opaque background.

title: Development / Workspace composition
owner: Existing Source + Reader + Terminal + Graph Code
workflow: Arrange the existing code explorer, terminal, Reader and code graph as a workspace; external editors remain native windows.
acceptance: Do not build a duplicate IDE, source writer or window manager to imitate an old concept image.

title: TFT / Ledger companion
owner: Existing read-only TFT ledger WebEngine view
workflow: Read round, board, shop, items, observations and historical decisions from the ledger.
acceptance: Visual refresh adds no gameplay control, no second state recorder and no training workload. Stale observations must be labeled.

title: Settings / Graph presentation
workflow: Choose presentation profile, graph Surface and existing layout controls without altering graph semantics.
acceptance: Do not add a second graph or fixed branch sectors; style-only edits leave simulation state intact.

data.intro: Presentation is separate from knowledge and simulation.

title: Settings / Input
workflow: Inspect the applied keyboard and mouse profile with hardware and effective sensitivity separated.
acceptance: Do not create per-Surface sensitivity, a second mouse profile store or direct pane-issued compositor commands.

data.intro: One input configuration across every Surface.
controls: Device-reported identity, not the marketing name.

Current setting, read-only until adapter support exists.

title: Settings / Workspace
workflow: Configure each Surface grid and the existing native tile/OLED behavior.
acceptance: Keep one 10-px grid, 5-px compositor-owned gaps and one persisted placement record per pane; no browser drag engine.

title: Settings / AI & Voice
workflow: Choose residency defaults and speech/camera devices; show when changes take effect.
acceptance: Opening Settings never starts audio or changes residency. Apply audio device changes through the existing session boundary.

data.intro: Device preferences are not an invitation to start capturing.
controls: Idle model defaults return when active Tasks release hardware.
Applies through the existing speech owner, not this pane.

title: Settings / Obsidience Themes
owner: Existing palette owner + staged theme catalog
workflow: Browse Obsidience Themes, preview a package and review the exact affected surfaces before applying it.
acceptance: This package is not currently activated. Keep palette.json authoritative, validate first, commit atomically, retain previous theme and provide rollback.

title: Launcher / Global search
workflow: Search applications, panes, files and existing knowledge as clearly separated result groups.
acceptance: Basic launching requires no model. Search results never auto-execute shell text; AI interpretation is an explicit opt-in action.

title: Workspace overview / Window switcher
workflow: Inspect current windows and Surfaces; activate a specific native target or restore a named layout.
acceptance: The overview is a projection, not a second geometry owner. Native window identity and stale-revision handling remain mandatory.

title: Quick settings / System tray
owner: Existing Linux services via thin Shell adapters
workflow: Open audio, network, Bluetooth, power and device controls from a compact status drawer.
acceptance: Reuse StatusNotifierItem and service adapters. Do not embed the KDE or GNOME shell or register competing service owners.

title: Notifications / History and focus
owner: Existing mako notification owner; bounded history projection
workflow: Read grouped notifications, activate explicit actions and toggle Do Not Disturb with app-level controls.
acceptance: Keep one org.freedesktop.Notifications owner. Do not start a Quickshell notification server beside mako; lock screen redacts private bodies.

title: Settings / Network & VPN
owner: NetworkManager; thin typed Shell service adapter
workflow: Choose Wi-Fi/Ethernet/VPN, inspect link state and handle connection requests through the proper secret agent.
acceptance: Never store or log passwords in theme state; bounded transactions report real connection state, not only requested state.

controls: Active interface and negotiated link speed.
Select a discovered network; credentials use a trusted native prompt.
Profile state, not a background model task.
Warn before large updates or model downloads.

title: Settings / Bluetooth
workflow: Discover, pair and disconnect devices with explicit pairing codes and per-device state.
acceptance: Never approve unknown pairing automatically; do not replace the system pairing agent without lifecycle handoff.

data.intro: Pairing is a deliberate action, not a notification click-through.
controls: Show adapter availability independently from discoverability.
Bonded input device; preserve alternate input during removal.
Show device identity and matching code before accepting.

title: Settings / Sound & media
workflow: Choose system input/output, adjust app streams and control existing MPRIS players.
acceptance: No competing audio capture pipeline. Mute/input and playback indicators reflect actual stream state.

title: Settings / Displays
workflow: Inspect output geometry, scaling, refresh, HDR and VRR; preview changes with a keep/revert deadline.
acceptance: Never change GPU routing or accepted HDR defaults on theme apply. Any output transaction must have timed rollback and a recovery path.

title: Settings / Accessibility
workflow: Adjust text scale, contrast, focus visibility, motion and keyboard navigation; inspect actual screen-reader support.
acceptance: Palette contrast alone is not accessibility conformance. Validate semantic labels, focus order, speech and magnification on the real native UI.

data.intro: Readable controls first. Decorative brass second.
controls: Increase control edges and remove texture.
No idle animation or flashing status.
Availability and startup must come from the installed assistive service.
Always show a two-pixel non-color-only focus outline.

title: Settings / Keyboard shortcuts
owner: Existing input/compositor adapter; no parallel shortcut store
workflow: Review current shortcuts and edit only supported commands with collision detection and rollback.
acceptance: Do not silently overwrite working tiling, recovery or accessibility shortcuts. Planned bindings require conflict review.

title: Settings / Power & idle
workflow: Inspect current power profile, lock/blank deadlines and inhibitors; expose platform-supported actions.
acceptance: Preserve this installation’s no-suspend policy. A theme does not rewrite idle/security listeners or allow applications to inhibit security locking.

data.intro: Presentation of existing policy; never a second idle daemon.

title: Session / Lock and power actions
owner: Existing LockController, logind and session helpers
workflow: Choose lock, sign out, restart or power off; inspect unsaved work and active tasks before destructive session actions.
acceptance: Never bind theme activation to a restart; do not imply lock complete before the existing owner confirms secure state.

title: Lock screen / Native secure surface
workflow: Restyle native identity and unlock controls on the existing opaque secure surface.
acceptance: The HTML sample is not a locker and accepts no credentials. Preserve black opaque output coverage, PAM isolation and fail-secure restart behavior.

title: Login / Session entry
workflow: Present user/session selection and native authentication for a fresh login.
acceptance: Login and lock are different owners. No HTML password collection; no unreviewed greeter replacement or changes to active boot/session configuration.

title: Permissions / Privileged action
source: Existing system polkit + supported native authentication agent
owner: polkit; graphical agent integration must be verified
workflow: Show requesting app, exact action and consequences with a trusted native authentication prompt.
acceptance: Expected hyprpolkitagent package was absent during inspection; another registered agent must be checked before declaring the whole service absent. Never authenticate through webviews or AI.

title: Files / General filesystem
source: Existing native file manager + XDG portals; appearance adapter (proposed)
owner: Maintained upstream file manager, not Article/Source writer
workflow: Browse home/devices/trash, move files, inspect properties and conflicts in a normal native application.
acceptance: Source remains provenance explorer. Prefer theming and launching Dolphin or another maintained file manager over building a duplicate file engine.

title: Files / Open and save dialog
workflow: Select a file or destination with clear filter, path, overwrite and sandbox permission boundaries.
acceptance: Do not bypass a sandbox with a custom raw filesystem chooser. Theme toolkit surfaces within supported limits.

title: Clipboard / Private history
owner: One optional Wayland clipboard history provider
workflow: Search a bounded local history, pin deliberate snippets, clear items and pause collection.
acceptance: Basic clipboard already exists. History is opt-in, secret/private selections excluded where supported, and lock clears or hides content; never harvest clipboard into AI memory.

title: Capture / Screenshot and sharing
owner: Existing capture/portal owner + ScreenCast session lifecycle
workflow: Choose one window, region or output; inspect save destination and explicit recording/sharing state.
acceptance: Keep visible recording indicators and stop/revoke controls. Do not create an additional continuous capture service or expose hidden windows.

title: Clock / Calendar
owner: System clock + explicit optional calendar provider
workflow: View date and timezone with an optional separately connected event source.
acceptance: No invented meetings. Offline calendar works without AI or account integration; source timezone is visible.

title: Settings / Removable devices
workflow: Inspect devices, filesystem capacity and mount state, then safely eject an exact target.
acceptance: Destructive disk formatting is not a casual quick action. Keep busy/mounted/error states and permissions explicit.

title: Settings / Printers
workflow: Choose a printer, inspect queue and job status, and open maintained configuration tools.
acceptance: Installed printer service and permissions must be checked before enabling controls. Never install drivers silently.

data.intro: Use the printing service, not a parallel queue.
controls: Available only when the host provides it.
No device is assumed from this design.

title: Settings / Privacy & permissions
owner: Existing portal permissions, Realtime state, Secret Service
workflow: Review app capture permissions, actual mic/camera activity and local data boundaries.
acceptance: KWallet was installed; do not claim no secret store. Show provider availability, never secret values; system permissions and AI Tool grants remain different.

data.intro: Desktop permissions are not model permissions.
controls: Display only active owners and current indicators.
Show portal sessions with a stop/revoke action.
Read provider availability without opening stored secrets.

title: Settings / Defaults & locale
owner: XDG MIME defaults + supported locale/time services
workflow: Choose default apps, language, formats and timezone through existing host services.
acceptance: Honor registered desktop IDs and MIME associations. Locale changes can require a new session; do not restart without confirmation.

data.intro: Ordinary desktop preferences, available without a model.
controls: Use system timezone data; show changes explicitly.

title: Settings / Startup applications
owner: Existing systemd user units + XDG autostart ownership
workflow: Inspect login applications and services with exact source and dependency information.
acceptance: No second startup scheduler; protect shell/lock/portal/audio owners and distinguish user apps from required session services.

data.intro: One lifecycle owner for every background process.
controls: Required session service; managed by existing units.
Inspect status without automatically restarting anything.

title: Settings / Accounts & identity
owner: System account services + explicitly connected providers
workflow: Inspect local identity and session avatar, then manage online connections through their real providers.
acceptance: Local account identity is not an Agent identity. Password/keyring changes remain native authenticated operations; no credentials in theme files.
